belongs_to_collection.name: The House on the Flatbed Collection

data.overview: A solitary veteran returns to the ruined homestead where his family was killed and begins dismantling it board by board, determined to rebuild somewhere peaceful. When the wartime commander responsible returns to finish the job, the veteran turns the cross-country move into a relentless chase.
data.tagline: What was broken can still be carried forward.
data.title: The House on the Flatbed
